title: PageBackendFilterExpression
description: Server-enforced filter expression for an entity page. A single condition or a nested and/or group tree that is always applied by the backend and cannot be removed by the client.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: use `backendFilter` for tenant, ownership, role, or workflow scoping that must not be user-editable. The root is either one condition or a group with `items`. Inside a group the first item has no `logic`; every following item must set `logic` to `and` or `or` to combine with the previous items. A condition names a `propertyName`, an explicit `operator` (never `default`), and exactly one value source: a static `value`, a `valueProvider` name registered in `AbpLowCodePageBackendFilterOptions` (for example `CurrentUserId`, `CurrentUserRoles`, `CurrentTenantId`), or a `javaScript` expression. `isNull`/`isNotNull` take no value source; `hasValue` takes a static boolean `value` (true = isNotNull, false = isNull); `between` takes two values; `in`/`notIn` take an array. Relative-date operators (`thisMonth`, `today`, ...) and `default` are not supported by backend filters; they belong to visible page filters.

logic.description: How this item combines with the previous items of the same group.

operator.description: Filter operator. Must be explicit; 'default' and relative-date operators are not allowed for backend filters. 'equals' is accepted as an alias of 'equal'. String properties support contains/notContains/startsWith/endsWith/equal/notEqual/in/notIn; numeric, money, and date/time properties support between/equal/notEqual/greaterThan/greaterThanOrEqual/lessThan/lessThanOrEqual/in/notIn; boolean, guid, and enum properties support equal/notEqual/in/notIn; isNull/isNotNull/hasValue apply to any property.

propertyName.description: Property on the page entity to filter.

value.description: Static filter value. Use an array for in/notIn, two values for between, and true/false for hasValue.

valueProvider.description: Name of a registered backend filter value provider, for example 'CurrentUserId' or 'CurrentUserRoles'.

javaScript.description: JavaScript expression evaluated on the server to produce the filter value.

items.description: Ordered child conditions and groups. The first item has no logic; later items require logic.
